text: Training Objective This course is designed to teach Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, and mathematics, etc, after one academic year (Fall and Spring Semesters, totally 36 weeks) or one semester (Spring Semester 15-17 weeks) continuous study in “Preparatory Course”, students can finally achieve the entry level of bachelor’s programs (offered in Chinese) at UIBE. In other words, and reach HSK 5-6 in Chinese; pass level of College Entrance Exam in mathematics (for arts students), and College English Test band 3 in English. Courses Offered · Fall Semester: 30 class hours per week (Chinese, request centralism studies by yourself) · Spring Semester: 29 class hours per week (Chinese, request centralism studies by yourself); 3 class hours per week (Mathematics); 3 class hours per week (English) Term Set · March - July for Spring Semester · September – January for Fall Semester: (Note: For exact registration time, please refer to Admission Notice) Application Period · April – June 10 for Fall Semester: · October – November 30for Spring Semester: Tuition · CNY 19,800/semester CNY 38,600/academic year · Advance payment of CNY 3,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester
